payload.reason: The evidence clearly states the sources of the GTF and VCF files used for predicting mutation effects on protein function.

claims.text: The GTF file containing the SARS-CoV-2 genome sequences was obtained from Ensembl.
The VCF file comprising all the SNPs of SARS-CoV-2 was obtained using the SNP-sites tool.
Both the GTF and VCF files for SIFT4G analysis are deposited in Figshare.
